bin/boardcheck.py: Covered by mcp/pair_mailbox/test_boardcheck.py and test_boardcheck_isolation.py; no bin-local sibling is needed.
bin/git-hooks/pre-push: The hook's policy and failure cases are covered by bin/pre_push_guard_test.py.
bin/pairchat: The command is a thin launcher for the pair-chat skill; its protocol behavior is covered by the waiting-contract suite.
bin/pairctl: The CLI delegates to pairctl_cli.py and pairctl_panes.py, covered by pairctl-panes and pairctl-read suites.
bin/pairrelaunch: Legacy compatibility launcher; end-to-end behavior is covered by pairup and pairrestart suites.
bin/pairreport: Read-only report wrapper; output and underlying report logic are covered by boardcheck and board-render suites.
bin/pairwatch: Legacy watch wrapper; lifecycle behavior is covered by watchdog and supervisor suites.
